name: – Marta Temido, Adam Jarubas – Amendments by the committee responsible – separate vote – Am 23
title: REPORT on the proposal for a Directive of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Directives 2001/18/EC and 2010/53/EU as regards the placing on the market of genetically modified micro-organisms and the processing of organs
part_text: (14c) In order to ensure that the rules applicable to genetically modified microorganisms remain effective and based on the best available scientific evidence, the Commission should regularly evaluate the implementation and functioning of Title II. The Commission should submit a report to the European Parliament and to the Council five years after the date of application of this Directive and every five years thereafter. That report should assess, in particular, the effectiveness, proportionality and efficiency of the authorisation procedures for GMMs, including the expedited procedure; the impacts of the measures of Title II on the environment, on health and on the agricultural system, including the organic and GMO-free sectors; the impact of Title II on market access for biotechnology products in the Union; and the progress made by the Authority on assessments of qualified presumption of safety (QPS). Where appropriate, the report should be accompanied by a legislative proposal, so that the framework can be adjusted in the light of scientific and technological developments and of the experience gained.
